base_commit: 553b1ea feat: add general task runtime foundation

implemented_capabilities.durable_state: implemented and unit-tested: versioned JSON snapshots, v0-to-v1 migration, atomic temporary-file write, file and directory sync, and malformed-state rejection
implemented_capabilities.execution_journal: implemented and unit-tested: append-only JSONL journal with stable Runtime event sequences and snapshot-to-journal reconciliation
implemented_capabilities.tool_execution: implemented and unit-tested: persisted requested/running/succeeded/failed/unknown-outcome calls, scoped artifact validation, timeout failure, bounded safe retry, and recovery by execution contract
implemented_capabilities.workspace_refresh: implemented and end-to-end tested: BLAKE3 digests, deleted-resource detection, selective evidence invalidation, and targeted replanning
implemented_capabilities.human_steering: implemented and unit-tested: persisted normalized constraint, explicit affected-goal selection, and controlled replacement planning
implemented_capabilities.runtime_api: implemented: TaskStore and DurableTask provide create, load/inspect, list, request/execute tool, resume/recover, cancel, events, input, and steering operations
implemented_capabilities.cli: implemented and process-end-to-end tested: task run, list, inspect, resume, input, steer, cancel, and events use TaskStore directly

resume_evaluations.normal_resume: passed: successful mutation persists before runtime drop and remains single-execution after load and resume
resume_evaluations.tool_started_crash: passed: a non-retry-safe mutation becomes unknown_outcome and waiting-for-user-input
resume_evaluations.checkpoint_interruption: passed: a deliberately truncated checkpoint is rejected
resume_evaluations.external_mutation: passed: only evidence tied to the changed resource is invalidated and only its completed goal is replaced

failure_injection.provider_error: not_tested: provider/session calls do not yet forward into the durable task journal
failure_injection.tool_timeout: passed: late read-only execution records failure and takes one bounded safe retry
failure_injection.tool_error: passed: the coding E2E records a failed validation before replanning
failure_injection.process_abort_after_tool_started: passed: non-retry-safe tool requires persisted user input
failure_injection.process_abort_after_file_write: passed for the post-success checkpoint boundary; partial snapshot rejection is separately tested
failure_injection.budget_exhaustion: passed in the rerun Phase 3 runtime evaluation suite
failure_injection.missing_capability: passed in the rerun Phase 3 runtime evaluation suite
failure_injection.user_interruption: passed through persisted unknown-outcome user-input state and steering test
failure_injection.multiple_runtime_instances: passed through restart and reload scenarios

checks: tool success has a unique preceding start
non-retry-safe mutating tool is not started twice
completed task cannot retain invalid evidence

surface_integration.acp: blocked/not integrated: ACP retains its existing session lifecycle and has no TaskId mapping or durable tool-loop forwarding
surface_integration.desktop: blocked/not integrated: desktop remains session-oriented; no local desktop dependency installation or lockfile was available for a reproducible boundary test

known_limitations: The durable runtime has no live provider-to-journal adapter, so provider timeout and provider error failure injection are not tested.
CLI task lifecycle persistence is real, but the existing provider-backed session agent has not yet been switched to drive DurableTask tool execution for arbitrary user goals.
ACP and desktop do not yet expose or control durable tasks.
The local volume reached less than 1 GB free while building focused CLI E2E artifacts; workspace-wide test and clippy gates are not complete.
The production Docusaurus build previously stalled after generated assets; it was not rerun in this disk-constrained pass.

release_gate.reason: ACP, desktop, provider forwarding, and final workspace-wide regression gates remain incomplete.
